坚固耐用RobustQQ- 普通噪声中 Wasserstein 不确定性下的平均场控制学习-learning for mean-field control under Wasserstein uncertainty in common noise

Mathieu Laurière Shanghai Center for Data Science; NYU-ECNU Institute of Mathematical Sciences, NYU Shanghai mathieu.lauriere@nyu.edu , Ariel Neufeld Division of Mathematical Sciences, Nanyang Technological University ariel.neufeld@ntu.edu.sg and Kyunghyun Park Division of Mathematical Sciences, Nanyang Technological University kyunghyun.park@ntu.edu.sg
（日期：。）(Date: .)
摘要。Abstract.

在本文中，我们提出了一个强大的In this article, we present a robustQQ-常见噪声定律中 Wasserstein 不确定性下的离散时间平均场控制问题的学习算法。 该算法将量化和投影方案与公共噪声空间上的 Wasserstein 对偶重构相结合。 我们为同步和异步学习方案建立了其收敛性和有限时间迭代界限。 系统性风险和流行病模型的数值实验将异步实现与理想化的贝尔曼迭代进行了比较，说明了常见噪声错误指定下的鲁棒性与性能权衡，并报告了观察到的异步实现的收敛行为-learning algorithm for discrete-time mean-field control problems under Wasserstein uncertainty in the common noise law. The algorithm combines a quantization-and-projection scheme with a Wasserstein dual reformulation on the common-noise space. We establish its convergence together with finite-time iteration bounds for both synchronous and asynchronous learning schemes. Numerical experiments on systemic risk and epidemic models compare the asynchronous implementation with an idealized Bellman iteration, illustrate the robustness–performance tradeoff under common-noise misspecification, and report the observed convergence behavior of the asynchronousQQ-学习算法。-learning algorithm.

关键词：Key words: QQ-学习、平均场控制、共同噪声、Wasserstein 不确定性、鲁棒优化、动态规划、随机逼近。-learning, mean field control, common noise, Wasserstein uncertainty, robust optimization, dynamic programming, stochastic approximation.

A. Neufeld gratefully acknowledges support by the MOE AcRF Tier 1 Grant RG109/25. K. Park acknowledges the support of the National Research Foundation of Korea (grant DOI: RS-2025-02633175).

1. 简介Introduction

平均场控制 (MFC)Mean-field control (MFC)[10, 14, 69]，也称为 McKean-Vlasov 控制，已成为具有大量合作智能体的动态随机系统研究中令人兴奋的进展来源。这些智能体采用相同的奖励和转换函数，同时通过其经验分布受到其他智能体的状态和行为的影响。根据平均场相互作用的概念, also referred to as McKean-Vlasov control, has become an exciting source of progress in the study of dynamic stochastic systems with large-population of cooperative agents. These agents take the same reward and transition functions, while being influenced by the states and actions of other agents through their empirical distributions. Under the notion of mean-field interaction[46, 39]，MFC 问题承认一种易于处理的重新表述：不是分析显式耦合代理的高维系统，而是解决代表性代理的优化问题，其中耦合被减少到不断演变的群体分布。这种范式已经发展成为一个活跃的跨学科领域，吸引了有理论倾向的数学家以及工程师和社会科学家。, MFC problems admit a tractable reformulation: rather than analyzing a high-dimensional system of explicitly coupled agents, one solves a representative agent’s optimization problem in which the coupling is reduced to the evolving population distribution. This paradigm has grown into an active interdisciplinary field attracting theoretically inclined mathematicians as well as engineers and social scientists.

现实的工程和经济应用通常需要所有代理都共有的随机源。事实上，交通系统的需求波动、机器人的环境干扰以及金融市场的流动性冲击提供了令人信服的证据，证明了在仅影响个体主体的特殊随机性之上纳入共同随机性的重要性（例如，Realistic engineering and economic applications often require a source of randomness that is common to all agents. Indeed, demand fluctuations in traffic systems, environmental disturbances in robotics, and liquidity shocks in financial markets provide convincing evidence for the importance of incorporating common randomness on top of the idiosyncratic randomness affecting only individual agents (e.g.,[27, 23, 33, 7]）。 介绍). The introduction of常见噪音common noise大大增加了 MFC 问题的建模和分析复杂性，因为由此产生的平均场相互作用本身变得随机，但它的结合对于捕获现实大群体系统中出现的总体随机性和系统效应仍然至关重要。这导致最近针对常见噪声的 MFC 问题的研究激增substantially increases both the modeling and analytical complexity of MFC problems, since the resulting mean-field interaction itself becomes stochastic, yet its incorporation remains essential for capturing aggregate randomness and systemic effects arising in realistic large-population systems. This has led to a recent surge of works on MFC problems with common noise[17, 64, 19, 20, 69, 65].

值得注意的是，在实践中实现具有常见噪声的 MFC 问题时会出现两个主要挑战。 首先，MFC 问题的解析解很少可用，而相应的数值方法通常存在高维问题。特别是，具有常见噪声的 MFC 问题可以表述为由代表平均场相互作用动力学的概率测量的随机流驱动的随机控制问题， 相应的最优性条件采用贝尔曼方程或在概率测度空间上定义的前向-后向方程的形式 （参见，例如，Notably, two major challenges arise when implementing MFC problems with common noise in practice. The first is that analytical solutions of MFC problems are rarely available, while the corresponding numerical methods typically suffer from high dimensionality. In particular, MFC problems with common noise can be formulated as stochastic control problems driven by stochastic flows of probability measures representing mean-field interaction dynamics, and the corresponding optimality conditions take the form of Bellman equations or forward-backward equations defined on spaces of probability measures (see, e.g.,[64, 17, 20, 21]）。因此，此类方程本质上是无限维的，这使得它们在分析上难以处理并且在数值上难以求解。). Such equations are therefore intrinsically infinite-dimensional, making them analytically intractable and numerically challenging to solve.

二是普通噪音的真实规律尚不清楚。因此，模型错误指定和估计错误是不可避免的，特别是当必须从人口测量流的有限或非平稳观测中推断出共同噪声定律时。至关重要的是，这种不确定性在具有常见噪声的 MFC 问题中很明显，因为概率测量流的动态本身就适应了常见噪声。因此，共同噪声定律的错误指定可能会导致不准确的随机控制公式和不可靠的解决方案。The second is that the true law of the common noise is unknown. Model misspecification and estimation errors are thus unavoidable, particularly when the common-noise law must be inferred from limited or non-stationary observations of population measure flows. Crucially, such uncertainty is apparent in MFC problems with common noise, since the dynamics of the probability measure flow are themselves adapted to the common noise. Consequently, misspecification of the common-noise law may lead to inaccurate stochastic control formulations and unreliable solutions.

本文旨在通过开发强大的解决方案来解决上述挑战This article aims to address the aforementioned challenges by developing a robustQQ-共同噪声不确定性下MFC问题的学习算法。-learning algorithm for MFC problems under common-noise uncertainty.QQ-学习及其变体-learning and its variants[86]，应用随机近似, which apply stochastic approximation[74]基于贝尔曼最优条件，是最广泛使用的强化学习范式之一。坚固耐用based on the Bellman optimality condition, are among the most widely used reinforcement learning paradigms. RobustQQ-学习-learning[12, 67, 92, 75, 60, 61, 66, 77]是该范式的最新进展，将分布稳健性纳入学习目标，以解决有限实际数据引起的不确定性和分布变化。以我们的配套文章为基础, a recent advancement of this paradigm, incorporates distributional robustness into the learning objective to address uncertainty and distributional shifts arising from limited real data. Building on our companion article[48]其中建立了涵盖共同噪声不确定性下离散时间鲁棒MFC问题的动态规划原理的理论框架， 我们的目标是在本文中开发相应的鲁棒性in which a theoretical framework covering the dynamic programming principle for discrete-time robust MFC problems under common-noise uncertainty is established, we aim to develop in this paper the corresponding robustQQ-学习算法及其收敛性分析。-learning algorithm and its convergence analysis.

Nevertheless, our setting involves several additional layers of difficulty beyond the classical framework. In particular, the lifted mean-field state-action structure requires the construction of suitable finite discretizations together with a corresponding approximation error analysis. Moreover, the incorporation of robustness through Wasserstein uncertainty leads to a significantly more delicate convergence analysis and finite-time error estimate, due to the additional min–max structure and distributional dependence of the problem.

4. 从平均场控制到From Mean-field control toQQ-学习-learning

We first show how this MFC problem is linked to the fixed-pointv∗v^{*}提案中成立established in Proposition2.4。特别是，最优的.
